title: The Room Keeps Its Own
prompt: A function works on its own private copy and hands back a gift. Predict what the outside keeps.

rounds.code:
count = 10
def add_one(n):
    n = n + 1
    return n
add_one(count)
print(count)
rounds.explain: add_one worked on its own local `n` and returned 11 — but nobody stored the gift, and the global `count` was never touched. Still 10. Locals stay local.
